author: Agent M (coordinator approval 2026-10-26)
rule_v03: replicates = held-out gain interval (patient bootstrap, 95 %) above zero AND every variable's within-patient correlation sign agrees between source and target cohort
rule_v03_1: replicates (v03.1) = replicates under rule v03 AND the target-cohort held-out gain exceeds the 95th percentile of that direction's matched-null held-out gains, both null types pooled (Moran-matched spatially smoothed fields and permuted programmes = random gene sets of the target programme's size, the same symbols in both cohorts)
reporting: both rules side by side in every table (cell under v03 and under v03.1; null false-transfer rate under each); the v03.1 column is never reported alone
null_records: every matched-null relation is stored with its type, relation, cell, held-out gain and interval (transfer_v03 null details); null counts >= 60 per direction where the source has enough transferable relations (independent draws per sampled relation)
reason: at Visium scale (tens of thousands of spots) a negligible held-out gain carries a bootstrap interval above zero, so the CI rule alone counts permuted-programme nulls as replications: Meylan -> GSE208253 OSCC 36 / 70 permuted nulls replicated under v03 (median gain 0.007) while 0 / 50 smoothed-field nulls did; switching off rank-normalisation within section left the OSCC rate unchanged (0.50 vs 0.514), so the permuted-programme nulls share a spot-quality axis with the relations' variables rather than a section effect
consistency: the same gain-based null logic as the CRC external replication (Agent R: replication judged against the matched-null gain distribution), so the P5 transfer tables and the external replication table use one rule
